[.walkthrough]
.Extract the form into a class
. Select the form: click a field, and press *←* for its parent. In its *⋮* menu, point at *Extract to Inner Component*.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/extract-component/01-extract.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/extract-component/01-extract.jpg"]
. Click it. Copilot moves the form and its fields into a class inside the view's class, `MyComponent`, and selects it: its [.walkthrough-look]#badge# now has the *↳* button of a component class.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/extract-component/02-result.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/extract-component/02-result.jpg"]
